mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_session_history(tenant_id,task_id,history_version,binding_snapshot,binding_digest,retain_until) SELECT tenant_id,id,#{version},#{binding},#{digest},TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,604800,created_at) FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_session_history SET body_bytes=body_bytes+#{additional} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND content_state='PRESENT' AND body_bytes+#{additional} BETWEEN 0 AND 7340032
